rule.sl:
**so** + pridevnik ali prislov + **that**: **It was so cold that we stayed in.** **Mr Tyson spoke so quietly that nobody heard.** **that** v govoru odpade. **such a** + (pridevnik) + samostalnik + **that**: **It was such a cold night that we stayed in.** Množina in kar se ne šteje brez a: **such bad weather**, **such nice people**. Koliko: **so much rain**, **so many people**, **such a lot of rain**. V Britaniji rečejo tudi *It was that cold we stayed in*; v pisanju so.

**whereas**, **while** (medtem ko) postavita dve dejstvi drugo ob drugo: **Jack likes the fell, whereas Sam likes the town.**

**Nevertheless,** (kljub temu) navadno začne nov stavek: **The road is narrow. Nevertheless, the bus gets through.** **On the other hand,** (po drugi strani) pove drugo plat, prej lahko **on the one hand**.

Red v govoru: **firstly**, **secondly**, **finally**, **to sum up**, **in conclusion**. Mnenje: **as far as I'm concerned**, **in my opinion**, **personally**.
rule.de:
**so** + Adjektiv oder Adverb + **that**: **It was so cold that we stayed in.** **Mr Tyson spoke so quietly that nobody heard.** **that** fällt gesprochen weg. **such a** + (Adjektiv) + Nomen + **that**: **It was such a cold night that we stayed in.** Plural und Unzählbares ohne a: **such bad weather**, **such nice people**. Wie viel: **so much rain**, **so many people**, **such a lot of rain**. In Großbritannien sagt man auch *It was that cold we stayed in*; geschrieben so.

**whereas**, **while** (während) stellen zwei Dinge einander gegenüber: **Jack likes the fell, whereas Sam likes the town.**

**Nevertheless,** (dennoch) beginnt meist einen neuen Satz: **The road is narrow. Nevertheless, the bus gets through.** **On the other hand,** (andererseits) nennt die andere Seite, davor auch **on the one hand**.

Ordnung in der Rede: **firstly**, **secondly**, **finally**, **to sum up**, **in conclusion**. Meinung: **as far as I'm concerned**, **in my opinion**, **personally**.
rule.it:
**so** + aggettivo o avverbio + **that**: **It was so cold that we stayed in.** **Mr Tyson spoke so quietly that nobody heard.** **that** a voce cade. **such a** + (aggettivo) + nome + **that**: **It was such a cold night that we stayed in.** Plurale e ciò che non si conta senza a: **such bad weather**, **such nice people**. Quanto: **so much rain**, **so many people**, **such a lot of rain**. In Gran Bretagna si dice anche *It was that cold we stayed in*; per iscritto so.

**whereas**, **while** (mentre) mettono a confronto due fatti: **Jack likes the fell, whereas Sam likes the town.**

**Nevertheless,** (tuttavia) di solito comincia una frase nuova: **The road is narrow. Nevertheless, the bus gets through.** **On the other hand,** (d'altra parte) presenta l'altra faccia, prima anche **on the one hand**.

Ordine nel discorso: **firstly**, **secondly**, **finally**, **to sum up**, **in conclusion**. Opinione: **as far as I'm concerned**, **in my opinion**, **personally**.
rule.en:
**so** + an adjective or an adverb + **that**: **It was so cold that we stayed in.** **Mr Tyson spoke so quietly that nobody heard.** In talk **that** may go. **such a** + (an adjective) + a noun + **that**: **It was such a cold night that we stayed in.** No a with plurals and what you can't count: **such bad weather**, **such nice people**. How much: **so much rain**, **so many people**, **such a lot of rain**. In Britain people also say *It was that cold we stayed in*; writing wants so.

**whereas**, **while** set two facts side by side: **Jack likes the fell, whereas Sam likes the town.**

**Nevertheless,** usually starts a new sentence: **The road is narrow. Nevertheless, the bus gets through.** **On the other hand,** gives the other side, with **on the one hand** before it.

An argument in order: **firstly**, **secondly**, **finally**, **to sum up**, **in conclusion**. An opinion: **as far as I'm concerned**, **in my opinion**, **personally**.

rule.sl: **so** + pridevnik + **that**: **so cold that**. **such a** + samostalnik + **that**: **such a cold night that**. **so much rain**, **so many people**. Dve dejstvi: **whereas**, **while**. Nov stavek: **Nevertheless,** Red: **firstly**, **to sum up**. Mnenje: **as far as I'm concerned**.
rule.de: **so** + Adjektiv + **that**: **so cold that**. **such a** + Nomen + **that**: **such a cold night that**. **so much rain**, **so many people**. Zwei Dinge: **whereas**, **while**. Neuer Satz: **Nevertheless,** Ordnung: **firstly**, **to sum up**. Meinung: **as far as I'm concerned**.
rule.it: **so** + aggettivo + **that**: **so cold that**. **such a** + nome + **that**: **such a cold night that**. **so much rain**, **so many people**. Due fatti: **whereas**, **while**. Frase nuova: **Nevertheless,** Ordine: **firstly**, **to sum up**. Opinione: **as far as I'm concerned**.
rule.en: **so** + an adjective + **that**: **so cold that**. **such a** + a noun + **that**: **such a cold night that**. **so much rain**, **so many people**. Two facts: **whereas**, **while**. A new sentence: **Nevertheless,** In order: **firstly**, **to sum up**. An opinion: **as far as I'm concerned**.

tip.sl: 💡 *Tako mrzla noč*: po angleško **such a cold night**, s **such a** spredaj.
tip.de: 💡 *Schlechtes Wetter* zählt man nicht: **such bad weather**, ohne a. *während* ist auch **while**: gleichzeitig und als Gegensatz.
tip.it: 💡 *Una notte così fredda*: in inglese **such a cold night**, con **such a** davanti.
tip.en: 💡 **so** before an adjective, **such a** before a noun: **so cold**, **such a cold night**.
